H2_calibration.quote: The $1 million daily cap may be small relative to the value of a frontier training run for large firms, so it could function as a cost of doing business.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: Training started during the 180-day window is neither grandfathered nor yet unlawful, and the bill doesn't say whether such a run must stop on the effective date. This creates an incentive to start runs before that date.
